summary: Demonstration only: the sample app permits withdrawals beyond its available balance.
limitations: Sample report is hand-written; no LLM audit was executed.

findings.title: Withdrawals can exceed available funds
findings.invariant: balance should not become negative after a normal withdrawal
findings.description: The amount is checked only for non-negativity; no balance cap exists.
findings.scenario: Starting with balance=100, call withdraw(150), resulting in -50.
findings.evidence: app.py lines 8-9 subtract amount without checking it against balance.
findings.recommendation: Refuse withdrawals above available balance before changing state.
findings.regression_test: Initialize balance=100, assert withdraw(150) raises and preserves balance.

golden_feature.name: Double-entry journal
golden_feature.mechanism: Make every balance mutation accountable and auditable
golden_feature.success_criterion: No invariant violations across test suite
golden_feature.novelty_check: Only single mutable balance variable exists in the example
